visual_identity.core_identity: A huge serpentine reptile with many pairs of short powerful legs, a horned predatory head, and a body built to coil through caverns.
visual_identity.silhouette: Very long snake-like torso wrapped in coils, numerous paired legs along the sides, horned head raised from the coil.
visual_identity.head_features: Long reptilian head with strong jaws and backward horns or spines; no wings.
visual_identity.body_shape: Serpentine torso with many pairs of short legs spaced along its length and a tapering tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Many repeated pairs of short sturdy reptilian legs attach along the long torso; no wings, humanoid arms, or insect segmentation.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple scales or ridge plates with minimal texture.

known_failure_modes.symptom: behir becomes four-legged or winged dragon
known_failure_modes.correction: restore long serpentine body, many paired legs, and no wings
restore reptilian head and continuous scaled serpentine torso
show enough repeated leg pairs to make multi-legged anatomy unmistakable

scene_identity.size_impression: Huge and tunnel-filling, with multiple coils and many leg pairs communicating length and mass.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Coiled or braced along cave floor, ledge, or wall with body weight visibly supported.
behavior_style: raising its head from grounded coils
